title: Funny or Not
question: What is the basis of 'sick' humour?

meanings.usage: 用来描述人、事物或情景能引人发笑的，语义中性偏褒义
指适用于所有情况、所有人或所有地区的，没有例外
表示人或事物具有的吸引他人的特质，常用搭配have appeal to sb.
作动词时常见搭配appeal to sb. for sth.（呼吁）、appeal to sb.（吸引某人）
不及物动词，固定搭配stem from，用来描述事物的来源或起因
指植物的茎部，也可引申为器物的柄、把
指以表演喜剧、讲笑话为职业的人
用来描述令人悲伤、不幸的事件或情况，与comic（喜剧的）是反义词
指事物不符合人的道德审美、让人觉得不舒服，程度比disgusting轻
指反复打扰、纠缠某人以达到自己的目的，常用搭配pester sb. to do sth.或pester sb. for sth.
强调对将要发生的不好的事感到极度担忧，常用搭配dread doing sth.或dread that从句
表示石膏时常用搭配in plaster（打了石膏），也可指建筑用的灰泥或者创可贴
用来描述人感觉非常不愉快、处境糟糕，也可形容事物令人难受
指在某人悲伤、失望的时候给予安慰，常用搭配console sb. with sth.
指因为腿或脚受伤而走路一瘸一拐的
常用搭配compensate sb. for sth.，表示为某人的损失、不好的经历给予补偿
指说话声音小且不清楚，通常因为不开心、醉酒或害羞

phrases.usage: 表示事物之间密切相关、密不可分，用来描述两个事物的关联性

examples.en: The future of the company is bound up with the development of new technology.
examples.zh: 这家公司的未来和新技术的发展密切相关。

examples.en: Personality is bound up with the environment one grows up in.
examples.zh: 性格和一个人的成长环境密不可分。

phrases.usage: 表示没能做到某事、未达成某个动作，比can't do更书面正式

examples.en: I failed to catch the last bus yesterday, so I had to take a taxi home.
examples.zh: 我昨天没赶上末班车，所以只好打车回家。

examples.en: The team failed to win the game even after three months of hard training.
examples.zh: 尽管经过了三个月的刻苦训练，这支队伍还是没能赢得比赛。

phrases.usage: 表示“以…为基础，根据…”，主语通常是故事、理论、判断等事物

examples.en: The movie is based on a real-life story that happened 20 years ago.
examples.zh: 这部电影是根据20年前发生的真实故事改编的。

examples.en: Your argument should be based on solid evidence instead of guesses.
examples.zh: 你的论点应该基于可靠的证据，而不是猜测。

phrases.usage: 表示“尽管，虽然”，后接名词/名词短语，用来引导让步关系，等同于despite

examples.en: In spite of the heavy rain, we still arrived at the meeting on time.
examples.zh: 尽管下着大雨，我们还是准时到达了会场。

examples.en: He kept on running in spite of his injured ankle.
examples.zh: 尽管脚踝受伤了，他还是继续跑步。

phrases.usage: 表示“开始流行，成为时尚”，主语通常是某种风格、事物、风潮

examples.en: Vintage clothes have come into fashion again among young people these years.
examples.zh: 这些年复古服装又在年轻人中流行起来了。

examples.en: Short haircuts came into fashion in the 1920s for women in Western countries.
examples.zh: 20世纪20年代，短发在西方国家的女性中开始流行。

phrases.usage: 表示“持续做某事，反复做某事”，强调动作的持续性和重复性

examples.en: If you keep on practicing English every day, you will make great progress soon.
examples.zh: 如果你坚持每天练习英语，很快就会取得很大进步。

examples.en: The little boy kept on asking his parents strange questions about the universe.
examples.zh: 这个小男孩不停问他父母关于宇宙的奇怪问题。

phrases.usage: 表示“鼓起勇气，振作起来”，是不及物短语，用来描述人在受挫后恢复信心

examples.en: When you face difficulties in study, take heart and you will find solutions finally.
examples.zh: 当你在学习中遇到困难时，振作起来，最终会找到解决办法的。

examples.en: The team took heart after their first victory and performed better in the following matches.
examples.zh: 这支队伍在首场胜利后振作了起来，在后续的比赛中表现得更好。

phrases.usage: 表示“果然，果真”，放在句首或句中，用来证明之前的猜测、预料是正确的

examples.en: I thought it would rain this afternoon, and sure enough, it started pouring at 3 o'clock.
examples.zh: 我就觉得今天下午会下雨，果然，三点的时候就开始下大雨了。

examples.en: She said she would bring me a gift when she came back from Japan, and sure enough, she gave me a delicate handcraft.
examples.zh: 她说从日本回来的时候会给我带礼物，果然，她给了我一个精致的手工艺品。

phrases.usage: 表示“在…上滑倒”，后接表示路面、地面的名词，强调滑倒的地点/原因

examples.en: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor when you enter the room.
examples.zh: 进房间的时候小心别在湿地板上滑倒。

examples.en: The old man slipped on the icy road and hurt his arm last winter.
examples.zh: 去年冬天这位老人在结冰的路上滑倒，伤到了胳膊。

sentences.en: Whether we find a joke funny or not largely depends on where we have been brought up.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得一个笑话好不好笑，在很大程度上取决于我们是在哪里长大的。

sentences.en: The sense of humour is mysteriously bound up with national characteristics.
sentences.zh: 幽默感与民族特点有着神秘的联系。

sentences.en: A Frenchman, for instance, might find it hard to laugh at a Russian joke.
sentences.zh: 例如，法国人可能觉得俄罗斯笑话不好笑。

sentences.en: In the same way, a Russian might fail to see anything amusing in a joke
sentences.zh: 同样，俄罗斯人可能觉得一个笑话没什么可乐的，

sentences.en: which would make an Englishman laugh to tears.
sentences.zh: 而这个笑话却能让英国人捧腹大笑。

sentences.en: Most funny stories are based on comic situations.
sentences.zh: 大多数有趣的故事都基于滑稽的情境。

sentences.en: In spite of national differences, certain funny situations have a universal appeal.
sentences.zh: 尽管存在民族差异，但某些滑稽情境具有普遍的吸引力。

sentences.en: No matter where you live,
sentences.zh: 无论你住在哪里，

sentences.en: you would find it difficult not to laugh at, say, Charlie Chaplin's early films.
sentences.zh: 你都会觉得很难不对，比如说，查理·卓别林的早期电影发笑。

sentences.en: However, a new type of humour, which stems largely from U.S., has recently come into fashion.
sentences.zh: 然而，一种主要源自美国的幽默新类型，最近流行起来。

sentences.en: It is called 'sick humour'. Comedians base their jokes on tragic situations like violent death or serious accidents.
sentences.zh: 它被称为“病态幽默”。喜剧演员将他们的笑话建立在悲剧情境上，例如暴力死亡或严重事故。

sentences.en: Many people find this sort of joke distasteful.
sentences.zh: 许多人觉得这种笑话令人反感。

sentences.en: The following example of 'sick humour' will enable you to judge for yourself.
sentences.zh: 下面这个“病态幽默”的例子能让你自己评判。

sentences.en: A man who had broken his right leg was taken to hospital a few weeks before Christmas.
sentences.zh: 一个右腿骨折的男人在圣诞节前几周被送进了医院。

sentences.en: From the moment he arrived there,
sentences.zh: 从他到达那里那一刻起，

sentences.en: he kept on pestering his doctor to tell him when he would be able to go home.
sentences.zh: 他就一直缠着医生，问他什么时候能回家。

sentences.en: He dreaded having to spend Christmas in hospital.
sentences.zh: 他害怕不得不在医院过圣诞节。

sentences.en: Though the doctor did his best, the patient's recovery was slow.
sentences.zh: 尽管医生尽了力，但病人的康复很慢。

sentences.en: On Christmas day, the man still had his right leg in plaster.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节那天，这个男人右腿上仍然打着石膏。

sentences.en: He spent a miserable day in bed thinking of all the fun he was missing.
sentences.zh: 他在床上度过了悲惨的一天，想着自己错过了所有的乐趣。

sentences.en: The following day, however, the doctor consoled him by telling him
sentences.zh: 然而，第二天，医生安慰他说，

sentences.en: that his chances of being able to leave hospital in time for New Year celebrations were good.
sentences.zh: 他赶在新年庆祝活动前出院的可能性很大。

sentences.en: The man took heart and sure enough, on New Year's Eve he was able to hobble along to a party.
sentences.zh: 男人振作起来，果然，在除夕夜他能一瘸一拐地去参加派对。

sentences.en: To compensate for his unpleasant experiences in hospital,
sentences.zh: 为了弥补他在医院的不愉快经历，

sentences.en: the man drank a little more than was good for him.
sentences.zh: 他多喝了一点酒，这对他身体不好。

sentences.en: In the process, he enjoyed himself thoroughly and kept telling everybody how much he hated hospitals.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，他玩得很开心，并且不停地告诉所有人他有多么讨厌医院。

sentences.en: He was still mumbling something about hospitals at the end of the party when he slipped on a piece of ice and broke his left leg.
sentences.zh: 派对结束时，他还在嘟囔着关于医院的事情，这时他滑到了一块冰上，摔断了左腿。

exercises.prompt: “吸引力，感染力” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: appeal · /əˈpiːl/ · noun · 吸引力，感染力。表示人或事物具有的吸引他人的特质，常用搭配have appeal to sb.

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：纠缠，烦扰
exercises.explain: pester · /ˈpestə(r)/ · verb · 纠缠，烦扰。指反复打扰、纠缠某人以达到自己的目的，常用搭配pester sb. to do sth.或pester sb. for sth.

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：Be careful not to _____ the wet floor when you enter the room.
exercises.hint: 进房间的时候小心别在湿地板上滑倒。

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：Many people find this sort of _____ distasteful.

exercises.explain: Many people find this sort of joke distasteful. — 许多人觉得这种笑话令人反感。

source.en: Many people find this sort of joke distasteful.

options: 定语从句（which/who引导的非限定性定语从句）
虚拟语气在条件状语从句中的用法（与过去事实相反）

选出下面句子的正确中文意思：

瑞典已逐步建立起一套完善的制度来保护公民不受专横或渎职的政府官员的侵害。
许多人觉得这种笑话令人反感。

grammar.title: 让步状语从句（No matter/Whether引导）
grammar.definition: 用来表达“尽管、无论”的让步逻辑，说明主句的动作不受从句条件的影响依然成立
grammar.structure: 1. Whether + 陈述句, + 主句；2. No matter + 疑问词（where/who/when等）+ 陈述句, + 主句
grammar.usage: whether引导时表示两种情况都不影响主句结果；no matter+疑问词引导时表示在任何该疑问词覆盖的情况下主句都成立，用于加强语气

examples.en: Whether you like the plan or not, we will carry it out next month.
examples.zh: 无论你喜不喜欢这个计划，我们下个月都会执行它。

examples.en: No matter how difficult the task is, we will try our best to finish it on time.
examples.zh: 无论这个任务有多难，我们都会尽全力按时完成。

grammar.title: 定语从句（which/who引导的非限定性定语从句）
grammar.definition: 用来对前面的名词或整个句子进行补充说明，去掉从句后主句依然完整，从句和主句之间通常用逗号隔开
grammar.structure: 主句 + , + which/who + 从句部分
grammar.usage: which指代事物或前面整句话的内容，who指代人，不能用that引导非限定性定语从句，用来提供额外的补充信息

examples.en: My favorite season is autumn, when the leaves turn yellow and the weather is cool.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的季节是秋天，那时树叶变黄，天气凉爽。

examples.en: He passed the final exam, which made his parents very happy.
examples.zh: 他通过了期末考试，这让他的父母非常开心。

patterns.pattern: Whether sb. find sth. adj. or not largely depends on ...

original.en: Whether we find a joke funny or not largely depends on where we have been brought up.
original.zh: 我们觉得一个笑话好不好笑，很大程度上取决于我们是在哪里长大的。

examples.en: Whether people find this movie touching or not largely depends on their own life experiences.
examples.zh: 人们觉得这部电影感不感人，很大程度上取决于他们自己的人生经历。

examples.en: Whether students find a subject interesting or not largely depends on the way the teacher teaches it.
examples.zh: 学生觉得一门课有没有意思，很大程度上取决于老师的授课方式。

patterns.pattern: To compensate for ..., sb. do sth. more than is good for sb.

original.en: To compensate for his unpleasant experiences in hospital, the man drank a little more than was good for him.
original.zh: 为了补偿他在医院的不愉快经历，这个男人喝得有点多，对身体不太好。

examples.en: To compensate for the time he wasted playing games last month, the boy studied much longer than was good for him every day before the exam.
examples.zh: 为了补偿上个月玩游戏浪费的时间，这个男孩在考试前每天学习的时间长得对身体都不好。

examples.en: To compensate for missing her daughter's birthday, the mother bought many gifts more than were good for the child.
examples.zh: 为了弥补错过了女儿的生日，这位妈妈买了太多对孩子并不好的礼物。

patterns.pattern: The following example of ... will enable you to judge for yourself.

original.en: The following example of 'sick humour' will enable you to judge for yourself.
original.zh: 下面这个“黑色幽默”的例子能让你自己做出判断。

examples.en: The following example of the new policy's effect will enable you to judge for yourself whether it is beneficial.
examples.zh: 下面这个关于新政策效果的例子能让你自己判断它是否有益。

examples.en: The following example of the product's practical use will enable you to judge for yourself if it is worth buying.
examples.zh: 下面这个关于产品实际使用的例子能让你自己判断它是否值得购买。
